prompt: I'm setting up a Plaid connector profile. The docs say I need to enter a redirect URI that goes to my app. Is that my platform, or my Plaid app? And why isn't it the StackOne callback URL I used for QuickBooks?
skill_note: Connectors territory, but the Plaid page does not answer it. Under the rule agreed on 2026-09-28, an undocumented answer is 'not covered, contact support', even if a general OAuth answer would be right.

fetch.name: checked-the-docs
fetch.note: The index or the Plaid page.

reply.name: points-to-support
reply.note: The docs name the channel as StackOne support.

reference: The Plaid connector page does not explain which redirect URI to enter, so the reply says the docs do not specify it.
The reply suggests contacting StackOne support rather than asserting an answer as documented.
The reply may explain in general terms how OAuth redirect URIs work, but does not present a Plaid-specific answer as coming from the docs.
